title: Waiver Authority for a Late Charge on Home Mortgage Loans
content:
Two grounds carry authority to waive a late charge on a Home Mortgage Loans note, and one limit applies to any waiver whatever its ground.

**Waiver as a bank error.** A late charge assessed contrary to the late charge policy is waived, on the ground of bank error.

**Courtesy waiver.** A courtesy waiver of a late charge is allowed while the number of courtesy waivers already granted on the customer's mortgage loans, over the rolling 365 calendar days ending on the current date, is below the program's courtesy waiver allowance, and the loan is not in forbearance.

**The limit on any waiver.** A fee can be waived at most once. The record of the fee itself is what a second waiver would be correlated to, and that fee having already been waived, no further waiver of it is made.

## The grounds compared

| Ground | What it turns on |
|---|---|
| Bank error | The charge having been assessed contrary to the late charge policy |
| Courtesy | The rolling count standing below the program's allowance, and the loan not being in forbearance |

The rolling count is a count of courtesy waivers, and the allowance it is measured against is stated of courtesy waivers.

## Basis questions

*Over what period is the courtesy count taken?* The rolling 365 calendar days ending on the current date.

*Whose waivers are counted?* Those granted on the customer's mortgage loans, taken together rather than loan by loan.

*What figure is the count measured against?* The courtesy waiver allowance of the program, which the loan's program schedule carries.

*What is the position when the count has reached the allowance?* It is no longer below the allowance, and a courtesy waiver is not allowed on that ground.

*What is the position while the loan stands in forbearance?* A courtesy waiver is not allowed.
